### Stepping Up for Sunnyvale
For nearly two decades, Linda Sell has stepped up for Sunnyvale when it mattered the most—working with neighbors to protect our quality of life, environment, and future. [READ MORE}
## How You Can Help
There are many ways you can help my campaign (and I greatly appreciate every bit of support):
- Volunteer (hand out flyers, block walk, etc.)
- Donate (always appreciated!)
- Host a campaign fundraiser
- Endorse my campaign (form on Endorsements page)
- Host a lawn sign
- Give a testimonial
### DONATE BY CHECK
Contributor checks should be made out to
“Linda Sell for Sunnyvale City Council D1 2026” .
(1) A completed remit form (download here) and (2) the contributor check should be mailed to
Linda Sell for Sunnyvale City Council D1 2026
PO Box 2931
Sunnyvale, CA 94087
Linda Sell for Sunnyvale City Council District 1 2026 FPPC#1488293
